description.value: Chickpea is a fully vegan Mediterranean food operation that started as a Vancouver street food truck in 2016 before expanding to a brick-and-mortar restaurant on Main Street. Built around housemade hummus and a broad roster of plant-based Mediterranean dishes, it has grown into a local institution prized for inclusivity and wholesome ingredients. Touring cyclists with vegan, vegetarian, or gluten-free needs will find the entire menu accommodating, with online ordering available for both the truck and the restaurant.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces) at 37m; rack at 67m; shed (50 spaces, covered, secure, paid) at 68m; rack at 68m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 72m; stands (5 spaces) at 76m; stands (5 spaces, covered) at 82m. Total: 72 spaces, 50 secure.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record is tagged street_vendor=yes, placing this as the mobile food truck rather than the brick-and-mortar restaurant; the website confirms both exist (truck + 4298 Main Street restaurant). Takeout and vegan/GF status are strongly confirmed: OSM carries diet:vegan=only and the website states 'Our entire menu is vegan, and most of our dishes are gluten free.' No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record is for the food truck (street_vendor=yes); the OSM coordinates (49.2251449, -123.0027055) appear significantly east of the restaurant at 4298 Main Street and likely reflect a single point-in-time truck parking spot rather than a fixed location — truck location is dynamic and tracked via the StreetFood app.
OSM email field reads 't catering@ilovechickpea.ca', which appears to be a corrupted entry (stray 't ' prefix); website lists info@ilovechickpea.ca as the primary contact email.
Phone (604-620-0602) and restaurant address (4298 Main Street, Vancouver, BC V5V 3P9) are sourced from the website only — OSM carries neither for this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, real business with a confirmed website, online ordering, and a well-documented presence in Vancouver; the entirely vegan menu makes it a valuable stop for touring cyclists with dietary restrictions.
enrichment_extras.notes: This OSM node represents the food truck, not the restaurant. The restaurant address and phone are included for reference, but cyclists seeking the truck should use the StreetFood app locator linked on the website.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Our entire menu is vegan, and most of our dishes are gluten free.'
